title: A short history of tarot: where the cards came from
description: How tarot grew from a fifteenth-century Italian card game into the deck used for tarot spread readings, from Visconti-Sforza to Rider-Waite-Smith.

scenes.headline: A short history of tarot: where the cards came from
scenes.caption: Tarot began as a card game in northern Italy. Its use for reading came centuries later.
scenes.vo: Tarot began as a card game in northern Italy. Its use for reading came centuries later.

scenes.headline: A card game in northern Italy, 1440s
scenes.caption: The earliest known tarot cards were made in northern Italy in the 1440s, in cities including Milan, Ferrara and Florence.
scenes.vo: A card game in northern Italy, 1440s. The earliest known tarot cards were made in northern Italy in the 1440s, in cities including Milan, Ferrara and Florence.

scenes.headline: From trionfi to tarocchi, 1500s to 1700s
scenes.caption: By the early 1500s the name tarocchi was in use, and the game spread across Italy and into France and central Europe.
scenes.vo: From trionfi to tarocchi, 1500s to 1700s. By the early 1500s the name tarocchi was in use, and the game spread across Italy and into France and central Europe.
